title: 真实Redis7.2启动恢复源：AOF优先于独立RDB，损坏时不能静默退回旧快照
answer:
```python
def recover(start,key,approved):
    with start(True) as command:
        actual=command('GET',key)
        fields=dict(line.split(':',1) for line in command('INFO','persistence').splitlines() if ':' in line)
        if fields.get('aof_enabled')!='1' or actual!=approved:raise ValueError('authoritative recovery watermark mismatch')
        return actual
```

原题知识说明：
通常AOF被视为更完整数据来源而优先使用，但文件组织和恢复细节依版本。审查启动日志与有效配置，隔离验证实际加载集，不能只替换RDB就假定覆盖AOF内容。
source: OpsForge 原创编审 2026-10-21；Redis官方文档核对

body:
## 操作任务
实现recover(start,key,approved)，start(appendonly:bool)是隔离恢复实例上下文，产出真实Redis command回调，退出关闭该实例。必须以appendonly=True恢复，确认INFO persistence的aof_enabled=1和GET key等于批准业务水位后返回水位；不符ValueError。若真实AOF启动因损坏抛异常，原样传播，不得改appendonly=False兜底旧RDB。平台同一不可改备份含旧独立snapshot.rdb与较新完整多段AOF，RDB文件mtime故意更晚；真实对照两种启动结果和AOF-only键，并检查坏增量AOF即使有可读RDB仍失败关闭。不得修改/删除源文件、只凭文件mtime选择恢复源或以PING成功代表恢复水位正确。

## 提交产物
task.py

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py；实际隔离原生进程与明确边界。

## 能力边界
真实Redis7.2.12与私有备份副本、AOF manifest/base/increment及独立RDB。所有启动在不同自建临时目录，不改变运行环境配置或生产实例；逻辑启动恢复验证不等于掉电fsync持久性、其他Redis版本选择策略、跨版本长期可恢复性或生产切换完成。与AOF重写/备份闭包题区别在同时存在两种格式时的真实启动源和坏权威源禁止静默降级。
rubric: 核心机制准确，说明适用前提
给出可观察的验收结果并说明必要边界

import sys,os,pathlib,tempfile,shutil,hashlib,contextlib,secrets
sys.path.insert(0,os.getcwd());sys.path.insert(0,str(pathlib.Path.cwd()/'checks'))
import task
from redis_native import NativeRedis
from redis_persistence_native import AOFRedis,await_aof
assert sys.platform=='linux' and os.geteuid()!=0
print('NATIVE_LINUX_READY',flush=True)
class AuthoritativeLoadFailure(RuntimeError):pass
class Restore(NativeRedis):
 def __init__(self,source,aof):self.source=source;self.aof=aof
 def start(self):
  shutil.copyfile(self.source/'snapshot.rdb',self.root/'snapshot.rdb');shutil.copytree(self.source/'appendonlydir',self.root/'appendonlydir')
  with self.config.open('a') as stream:stream.write('\nappendonly '+('yes' if self.aof else 'no')+'\nappendfsync always\nappenddirname appendonlydir\nappendfilename appendonly.aof\n')
  try:super().start()
  except RuntimeError:
   log=(self.root/'redis.log').read_text(errors='replace')
   if self.aof and 'Bad file format' in log:raise AuthoritativeLoadFailure('real authoritative AOF startup rejected')
   raise
def snapshot(path):return {p.relative_to(path).as_posix():hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in path.rglob('*') if p.is_file()}
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='of-load-source-') as directory:
 root=pathlib.Path(directory);good=root/'good';good.mkdir();key='watermark-'+secrets.token_hex(5);old='rdb-old-'+secrets.token_hex(4);approved='aof-new-'+secrets.token_hex(4)
 with AOFRedis() as server:
  await_aof(server.command);server.command('SET',key,old);server.command('SET','stable-key','preserved');assert server.command('SAVE')=='OK'
  rdb=(server.root/'snapshot.rdb').read_bytes();server.command('SET',key,approved);server.command('SET','new-aof-only','committed');await_aof(server.command)
  server.stop();assert (server.root/'snapshot.rdb').read_bytes()==rdb,'controlled shutdown changed older standalone RDB'
  shutil.copyfile(server.root/'snapshot.rdb',good/'snapshot.rdb');shutil.copytree(server.root/'appendonlydir',good/'appendonlydir')
 # Deliberately newer file metadata is teaching input, never a system-clock change.
 os.utime(good/'snapshot.rdb',(2100000000,2100000000));protected=snapshot(good)
 with Restore(good,False) as rdb_server:assert rdb_server.command('GET',key)==old and rdb_server.command('GET','new-aof-only') is None
 with Restore(good,True) as aof_server:assert aof_server.command('GET',key)==approved and aof_server.command('GET','new-aof-only')=='committed'
 print('NATIVE_REDIS72_APPENDONLY_YES_LOADS_AOF_NOT_NEWER_MTIME_STANDALONE_RDB',flush=True)
 print('STUDENT_OPERATION_ENTERED:recover_authoritative_aof_watermark_without_silent_rdb_fallback',flush=True)
 attempts=[]
 @contextlib.contextmanager
 def start(aof):
  assert isinstance(aof,bool);attempts.append(aof)
  with Restore(good,aof) as server:
   yield server.command
   assert server.command('GET','stable-key')=='preserved'
 try:actual=task.recover(start,key,approved)
 except Exception as error:raise AssertionError('student authoritative recovery failed') from error
 assert actual==approved and attempts==[True],'recovery chose stale RDB or skipped real verification'
 assert snapshot(good)==protected,'immutable recovery source changed'
 attempts.clear()
 try:task.recover(start,key,'unapproved-watermark')
 except ValueError:pass
 else:raise AssertionError('recovered business watermark was not checked')
 assert attempts==[True] and snapshot(good)==protected
 broken=root/'broken';shutil.copytree(good,broken);manifest=broken/'appendonlydir/appendonly.aof.manifest'
 incr=next(line.split()[1] for line in manifest.read_text().splitlines() if line.split()[-1]=='i');piece=manifest.parent/incr;raw=piece.read_bytes();assert raw.startswith(b'*');piece.write_bytes(b'!'+raw[1:]);broken_before=snapshot(broken);attempts=[]
 @contextlib.contextmanager
 def broken_start(aof):
  attempts.append(aof)
  with Restore(broken,aof) as server:yield server.command
 try:task.recover(broken_start,key,approved)
 except AuthoritativeLoadFailure:pass
 else:raise AssertionError('corrupt authoritative AOF silently fell back to old RDB')
 assert attempts==[True] and snapshot(broken)==broken_before and snapshot(good)==protected
 print('NATIVE_REDIS_REAL_CORRUPT_AOF_STARTUP_FAILURE_PROPAGATES_WITHOUT_STALE_SNAPSHOT_FALLBACK',flush=True)
print('NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED',flush=True)
